title: Subsets
prompt: Given an integer array `nums` of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set). The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets; you may return the subsets in any order.
constraints: All elements of nums are unique.
hints: Think recursively: for each element, you either include it in the current subset or you don't.
A backtracking template works well: build up a path, recurse on the rest of the array, then undo the choice.
There's also an iterative approach: start with [[]] and for each number, add it to every existing subset to double the list.
